row: Dave Taylor is delighted to be offering Raynor Massage in the UK and Ireland. These massage courses use training techniques that teach you effective massage in a short time. If you are thinking about a different direction in life this training will leave you fully qualified and ready to embark on a brand new, rewarding career. Visit http://www.davetaylortraining.co.uk/
